details:
Currently, the Avatar Ranking System, as far as most are aware, is targeted, on mobile, towards what is deemed as "performant" on Quest 1 hardware.

**However**, Quest 2 hardware, in many ways, excels beyond that of first generation equipment. — In many ways, avatars on Quest ranked "very poor", *but with stats equivalent to "Medium" or "Good" on PC*, run well on the system, **with no noticeable performance decrease compared to their higher-ranked siblings**.

As such, whilst it would be good to *maintain shared* ***limitations*** *in regards to avatar components*, between Quest 1 and Quest 2, the *rankings provided to avatars should be adjusted when displayed on Quest 2 hardware*.
Not only would this allow avatars to have a fairer ranking, when displayed to Quest 2 users, but it would allow Quest 2 content developers to utilize more SDK3 features (props, interchangeable clothes, materials) without being penalized by the ranking system for reasonable mesh-renderer counts, material slots, and/or reasonable poly-counts above the current 20K limit.

In practice, the VRCSDK would remain mostly unchanged, providing the Quest 1 avatar ranking. However, based on the avatar's stats, a Quest 2 ranking would also be assigned.

The VRC mobile client would then identify the hardware generation being ran on (Quest 1, Quest 2), and use the ranking relevant to its hardware.
title: Add Variated Avatar Rankings for Quest 2 Hardware
